documents.title: Noting In The Board Meeting Dated 29.10.2026 Delay In Submission Of Shareholding Pattern Under Reg 31(1)(B) To NSE.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Menon Bearings reported strong financial and operational performance for Q2 and H1 FY27, with consolidated revenue from operations increasing by 58.6% YoY to Rs 100.88 crore and PAT growing by 117.1% YoY to Rs 14.73 crore. Management highlighted ongoing capacity expansions, robotic automation roadmaps, and strategic energy initiatives aimed at sustainability and cost savings. The company is actively expanding its footprint in export markets, targeting the EV segment, and developing high-margin products across its business divisions. Menon Bearings Limited presented its Q1 FY27 financial performance, reporting record quarterly sales, EBITDA, PBT, and profit after tax. Management outlined growth opportunities arising from recent trips to the US and Canada, new customer RFQs, and product developments across the bi-metal, Alkop, and brake segments.

guidance.claim: The company expects additional potential business of INR 65 crores to INR 75 crores across the current and next financial years.
guidance.quote: The total potential of additional business for the current and next financial year is expected to be around INR65 crores to INR75 crores, subject to good monsoon and geopolitical situation doesn't worsen further.

guidance.claim: The company is targeting revenues of INR 100 crores for the Alkop division in the current year and around INR 125 crores in the next year.
guidance.quote: For this year, we are targeting Alkop for INR100 crores, next year around INR125 crores.

guidance.claim: Management expects exports to reach up to 37% of total revenue by next year.
guidance.quote: As we expect that by next year, the export may go up to 37% after total revenue.

guidance.claim: Management considers INR 360 crores to be a conservative revenue figure for the year.
guidance.quote: INR360 crores, I would say is a conservative figure and we will stick to that.

guidance.claim: Management expects to sustain consolidated margins around 20% to 21% over time.
guidance.quote: But overall, on a consolidated basis, if you see, we will sustainaround 20% to 21% of margins over a period of time.

guidance.claim: The company maintains a conservative annual revenue growth target of over 20% year-on-year.
guidance.quote: You see, there is always a target, we have set ourselves on a conservative basis of 20% plus year on year.

demand_outlook.claim: Underlying demand outlook for the automotive and engineering sector remains encouraging despite global business uncertainties.
demand_outlook.quote: While the global business environment continues to present certain uncertainties, the underlying demand outlook for the automotive and engineering sector remains encouraging.

demand_outlook.claim: The company is experiencing strong demand and receiving significant attention from customers in the USA.
demand_outlook.quote: We are getting a lot of attention and demand from the USA.

demand_outlook.claim: The third and fourth quarters are typically stronger for the company and less impacted by automotive industry cyclicality.
demand_outlook.quote: Third, fourth quarter, if you see, normally are much better. They are not affected by the cyclic nature of this auto industry.

capex_expansion.claim: Brake capacity has an additional Rs 2.50 crore planned over next 2 years.
capex_expansion.quote: ₹0.58 crore fully deployed in FY26 with ₹2.50 crore additional planned over next 2 years

capex_expansion.claim: The company is investing INR 9 crores to INR 10 crores in the current financial year to expand capacity by 25% to 30%.
capex_expansion.quote: If you go through the presentation, Rucheeta, you will come to know that we are investing about INR9 crores to INR10 crores of rupees for this year, this financial year for increasing the capacity and which is expected to increase the capacity by almost 25% to 30%, which may yield the total revenue of more than INR25 crores, which can generate revenue of INR25 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has allocated around INR 4 crores of CapEx for the Alkop division during the current financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: And we are having the CapEx of around INR4 crores of for this year in Alkop alone.

capex_expansion.claim: The company constructed a new 65,000 square feet building and machine shop in the aluminium division.
capex_expansion.quote: And in aluminium division also, we have done 65,000 square feet new building, a machine shop, which is 50% land, like what do you say?

capex_expansion.claim: Future CapEx is expected to generate an asset turnover ratio of around 2.5.
capex_expansion.quote: See, whatever future CapEx that we are going to do, the additional CapEx will have asset turn of around 2.5.

margins_costs.claim: Solar power system output is approximately 53,67,828 kWh/year.
Energy-efficient LED motors, lighting, and electric holding boilers provide specific energy savings.
EBITDA margins for the brakes segment reached 25% during the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: But at the same time, I would like to tell you that right from 12% EBITDA earlier, now we have reached to 25% EBITDA in brakes also.

margins_costs.claim: Prices of consumable carbide tools have increased by 300%.
margins_costs.quote: Those carbide tools price are increased by 300%.

margins_costs.claim: Management improved margins despite raw material prices increasing by 20% to 25%.
margins_costs.quote: You see, even after increasing the raw material prices by about 20%, 25%, still, not only we have sustained, but our margins have increased further.

margins_costs.claim: Strategic sustainability initiatives including solar power, efficient motors, LED lighting, electric holding boilers, and pre-heat furnaces help achieve cost savings and operational efficiency.
margins_costs.quote: These strategic initiatives demonstrate a commitment to sustainability, operational efficiency, and cost savings.

orders_capacity.claim: Installed capacity for brake lines is 30 lakh units/annum.
orders_capacity.quote: Installed capacity 30 lakh units/annum for Brake Lines

orders_capacity.claim: The combined list of RFQs under consideration for the Alkop and Bi-metal divisions stands at approximately INR 75 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: So, put together, Alkop, that is Aluminium and Bi-metal put together, the list of such RFQ list is about INR75 crores of rupees apart from the potential business that we may get through our visits to Canada and USA, that is different.

orders_capacity.claim: Peak achievable revenue from the existing bi-metal bearing division is above INR 400 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Peak revenue from this, it can be aboveINR400 crores.

orders_capacity.claim: The company initiates capacity expansion CapEx whenever utilization crosses 80%.
orders_capacity.quote: Whenever we reach 80% of the utilization, looking at the RFQs in hand and the business on the horizon, we go for -- we see.

capital_allocation.claim: CapEx for both bi-metal and Alkop segments will be funded entirely through internal accruals without taking fresh debt.
capital_allocation.quote: You see, so far as whatever we are considering so far as bi-metal and Alkop is concerned, it will be through internal accruals only, no fresh loan will be taken.

capital_allocation.claim: The board has declared a dividend of Rs. 2 per share having a face value of Re. 1 each.
capital_allocation.quote: Note: The Board has declared Dividend of Rs. 2 per share having face value of Re. 1 each

risks_headwinds.claim: Merchant export orders were delayed over the past three months due to backlogs caused by war and disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz.
risks_headwinds.quote: So actually, our results could have been even better. But last three months, those merchant export orders were stuck because of backlog because of the Straight of Hormuz and the war.

risks_headwinds.claim: Drought-like conditions in certain parts of India may temporarily impact tractor segment demand.
risks_headwinds.quote: You see, considering the monsoon position that may -- in tractor segment affect today to some extent, not larger, because in some parts there is a drought-like situation, but it is expected to improve within this month or next month.

risks_headwinds.claim: Steep price competition from China in Dubai and African markets limits export margins on brake linings.
risks_headwinds.quote: And since there is a steep competition from China, particularly in Dubai and African countries for brake linings, we have to keep the minimum margins so far as exports are concerned to these countries.

management_commitments.claim: Dual-CNC robotic cell installation is underway for Nov 2026.
Dual-VMC robotic cell execution is in progress for Jan 2027.
management_commitments.quote: Design complete; execution in progress Jan 2027

management_commitments.claim: Dual-VMC robotic cell simulation and design is underway for Mar 2027.
Vision inspection and powder coating automation design exploration is set for Apr 2027.
